text: You read "Near-vertical thrust ... the power-play precondition." A precondition is not the trigger, and you concede "No flag yet." On my tape the thrust has stopped: structure_shift RANGE, mp DECELERATING, day_vol 0.97 below normal, sma_dist 46.6%. That is a reaction after a big run, not a fresh high (C5). The final leg can be the biggest (C15), so I do not call it over either; I wait for the price to tell me. What clears it: a BULLISH_BOS out of the range on above-normal participation. That would be the flag breaking, and I would support.
